name: Apple Vision Pro (M5)

sources.title: Apple Vision Pro - Technical Specifications (apple.com)
sources.covers: chips (M5, R1 and its latency), sensors, input, refresh rates, weight, connectivity

note: The specifications page (the M5 model): "Apple R1 chip | 12‑millisecond photon‑to‑photon latency" (latency_ms 12: the passthrough display path, not a hand-tracking-to-robot latency); "Six world‑facing tracking cameras", "Four eye‑tracking cameras", "TrueDepth camera", "LiDAR Scanner", "Four inertial measurement units (IMUs)"; input "Hands | Eyes | Voice"; "Supported refresh rates: 90Hz, 96Hz, 100Hz, 120Hz" (display rates; tracking_hz null). "Device Weight 26.4–28.2 ounces (750–800 grams)" with Light Seal and Dual Knit Band, "Separate battery weighs 353 grams" (mass_g 800, the upper end of the headset's range). Not stated: a hand-tracking rate or accuracy, a tracking volume.
